---
title: Typography & Fonts
description: Typography scales, named typography roles, fluid font sizes, and Google Font loading.
---

The theme package provides base typography scales, a set of named typography roles used by the `Heading` and `Text` components, and first-class Google Font loading for three font roles.

## Font roles

Fonts are organized into three roles (`FontRole`): `heading`, `body`, and `accent`. Each role resolves to a font family variable, emitted under two equivalent names:

- `--puzzle-font-heading` / `--puzzle-font-family-heading`
- `--puzzle-font-body` / `--puzzle-font-family-body`
- `--puzzle-font-accent` / `--puzzle-font-family-accent`

Without configured fonts, every role falls back to `"Open Sans", sans-serif`.

## Loading Google Fonts

Pass a `fonts` map to `Theme`. Each entry is a `FontConfig`:

| Field      | Type                                                      | Default             | Description                      |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `family`   | `GoogleFontFamily`                                        | —                   | A typed Google Font family name. |
| `weights`  | `readonly number[]`                                       | role-based defaults | The weights to load.             |
| `styles`   | `readonly ("normal" \| "italic")[]`                       | `["normal"]`        | Font styles to load.             |
| `display`  | `"auto" \| "block" \| "swap" \| "fallback" \| "optional"` | `"swap"`            | The CSS `font-display` strategy. |
| `fallback` | `readonly string[]`                                       | role-based defaults | Fallback font families.          |

```tsx
<Theme
  fonts={{
    heading: { family: "Sora", weights: [600, 700] },
    body: { family: "Inter" },
    accent: { family: "JetBrains Mono", styles: ["normal", "italic"] },
  }}
>
  <App />
</Theme>
```

`Theme` renders the Google Fonts preconnect links and one stylesheet link per font, and builds properly quoted `font-family` values including your fallbacks.

### Standalone font loading

`GoogleFont` loads a single font and sets its role variable without the rest of the theme system. Prefer `Theme` when you want the full token system.

```tsx
import { GoogleFont } from "@puzzle-ui/theme";

<GoogleFont family="Inter" role="body" />;
```

### createGoogleFontUrl

Builds a Google Fonts CSS2 stylesheet URL for a font configuration:

```tsx
import { createGoogleFontUrl } from "@puzzle-ui/theme";

const href = createGoogleFontUrl({
  family: "Inter",
  weights: [400, 700],
  styles: ["normal", "italic"],
  display: "swap",
});
```

## Base typography scales

These token groups form the raw scales. Font sizes use `rem` and letter spacing uses `em`.

| Group                      | CSS variable                         | Keys                                                                         |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `typography.fontSize`      | `--puzzle-font-size-{key}`           | `xs` (0.75rem) … `6xl` (3.75rem), with `base` = 1rem                         |
| `typography.fontWeight`    | `--puzzle-font-weight-{key}`         | `normal` 400, `medium` 500, `semibold` 600, `bold` 700, `extrabold` 800      |
| `typography.lineHeight`    | `--puzzle-font-line-height-{key}`    | `none` 1, `tight` 1.15, `snug` 1.3, `normal` 1.5, `relaxed` 1.625, `loose` 2 |
| `typography.letterSpacing` | `--puzzle-font-letter-spacing-{key}` | `tighter` −0.05em … `widest` 0.1em                                           |
| `typography.fontGap`       | `--puzzle-font-gap-{key}`            | `headingStackGap`, `headingParagraphGap`, `paragraphGap`, `sectionGap`       |

## Typography roles

Named roles (`TypographyStyle`) describe complete text styles. Each role resolves to a font role plus size, weight, line height, and letter spacing, emitted as:

- `--puzzle-font-family-{role}`
- `--puzzle-font-size-{role}`
- `--puzzle-font-weight-{role}`
- `--puzzle-font-line-height-{role}`
- `--puzzle-font-letter-spacing-{role}`

| Role        | Font    | Size          | Weight | Notes                 |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| `display1`  | heading | 40–80px fluid | 300    | Largest display text. |
| `display2`  | heading | 36–60px fluid | 300    |                       |
| `headline1` | heading | 32–48px fluid | 400    |                       |
| `headline2` | heading | 28–36px fluid | 400    |                       |
| `headline3` | heading | 22–28px fluid | 400    |                       |
| `headline4` | heading | `xl` scale    | 500    |                       |
| `subtitle1` | heading | `base` scale  | 500    |                       |
| `subtitle2` | heading | `sm` scale    | 500    |                       |
| `body1`     | body    | `base` scale  | 400    | Default body text.    |
| `body2`     | body    | `sm` scale    | 400    |                       |
| `button`    | body    | `sm` scale    | 500    |                       |
| `caption`   | body    | 12px          | 400    |                       |
| `overline`  | body    | 10px          | 500    |                       |

The larger roles use fluid font sizes built with `clamp()`, scaling smoothly between a minimum and maximum size across viewport widths. The smaller roles reference the base font-size scale, so overriding `typography.fontSize` flows through to them.

### Overriding roles

Roles can be overridden per property through `tokens.typography.roles`:

```tsx
<Theme
  tokens={{
    typography: {
      roles: {
        headline1: { fontWeight: "600" },
        body1: { lineHeight: "1.6" },
      },
    },
  }}
>
  <App />
</Theme>
```

Each role override accepts `font` (a font role), `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `lineHeight`, and `letterSpacing`.
